elements.char: position and, as we will see in the following, for various network structures and states. Thus

elements.label: text

elements.char: well for a broad set of conditions (input intensity, neuron morphology, synaptic distribution),

elements.char: and this means crucially that the proxy can be used also under weak assumptions about the
